solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, mirror symmetry); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Local scribe, I'm potentially one rising in company?

indicators.note: what these words could potentially become once their letters are reworked, so they are an anagram

explanation.surface: Looking at a parish scribe and wondering whether this humble writer might be an ambitious upstart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'potentially' rearranges LOCAL SCRIBE I'M. The question mark flags the playful definition: 'company' is society, not a business.
explanation.definitionFit: A status-seeker tries to move up in society, the 'company' they keep, so is literally one rising through it.

clue.text: Upset, criticizes card game

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the letters read from the bottom up

parts.note: to pan a show is to criticize it harshly

explanation.surface: Someone, annoyed, complains about a game of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Snap is a children's card game where players shout on spotting a matching pair.

clue.text: Explain king being aboard vessel

indicators.note: being aboard puts one thing on the inside of a vessel, so these letters go inside the other piece

parts.note: a cup is a drinking vessel
Lear is Shakespeare's king

explanation.surface: A request to explain why a monarch is on a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'king' is Shakespeare's King Lear, not R or K.
explanation.definitionFit: To resolve a mystery is to explain it; the phrasal verb means sort out or solve.

clue.text: Strange answer: something that's not true name

parts.note: a lie is a statement that is not true

explanation.surface: An odd reply, calling a name false.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means foreign or unfamiliar, hence strange.

clue.text: Talk about the French house

indicators.note: talk goes about, around, the other piece, so it wraps it

parts.note: to chat is to talk
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Discussing the French house, perhaps a property in France.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss-style wooden dwelling, a type of house often found in the Alps.

clue.text: Opening adaptation not outward looking

definitions.note: adjectival phrase standing for the noun state of being inward-looking

parts.note: an intro is an opening passage of music or a speech
a version is an adaptation of an original work

explanation.surface: An adaptation's opening that lacks outward perspective, like a cover song that stays insular.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names the quality of looking inward rather than outward, the shy, self-focused temperament.

clue.text: With Society involved, overcome cruel person

indicators.note: Society is involved in, wrapped up within, the other word

parts.note: to beat an opponent is to overcome them

explanation.surface: With the help of a society, a tyrant is defeated.
explanation.definitionFit: A brutal person is called an animal, a monster of cruelty.

clue.text: Eyed a dog, stray, mongrel: prepare to run!

indicators.note: a mongrel is of mixed breed, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A dog-themed scene: a stray mutt is eyed, and it's time to flee!
explanation.walkthrough: 'mongrel' looks like part of the canine picture but is the anagram signal for EYED A DOG STRAY.
explanation.definitionFit: The starter's call before a race tells competitors to get set to sprint.

clue.text: Part of Potomac I remarked about — its location

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the run is read backwards
only a part of these words is used, a run of consecutive letters

explanation.surface: Someone mentions the Potomac river and remarks on where it is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part of' picks ACIREMA from POTOMAC I REMARKED; 'about' turns it round. The definition leans on the clue: 'its' is the Potomac, a river in the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: The Potomac flows through the United States, so that country is where the river lies.

clue.text: Thanks artist carrying island headwear

indicators.note: the first pair of pieces carries, holds inside, the next one

parts.note: ta is informal British for thanks
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: Thanking a painter who brings back a hat from an island.
explanation.definitionFit: A jewelled crown-like band is an item worn on the head.

clue.text: Embarrassing cold call they row about

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
to give someone a ring is to call them

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An awkward cold call from people bickering.
explanation.definitionFit: Something toe-curling makes you wince with embarrassment, deserving a shudder.

clue.text: Queen's emblem features musicians

indicators.note: features says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A royal badge depicts a band of players, as if on the monarch's crest.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of performers playing together, such as a chamber group, is a musical company.

clue.text: Asian cultivated alpine

indicators.note: cultivated soil is worked over, so these letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: An Asian plant grown in mountain conditions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alpine' reads as a plant, but it is the fodder, and the definition is the Himalayan nationality.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Nepal, a Himalayan country, is an Asian.

clue.text: Most unproductive meadow home

parts.note: a lea is a poetic word for a meadow
a nest is a bird's home, or a cosy home

explanation.surface: A homestead set in the least fertile meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: Lean as in a lean year means sparse and unfruitful, so the superlative is least fruitful.

clue.text: Refreshment source regularly using the camp boat

indicators.note: regularly using means taking letters at a regular interval, every other one

explanation.surface: Holidaymakers routinely bring a drinks supply on the camp's boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A brewing pot is where a cup of tea, a refreshing drink, comes from.

clue.text: Much liked tree outside university

indicators.note: the tree goes outside, around, the other piece

parts.note: a poplar is a tall tree

explanation.surface: A beloved tree stands outside the campus.
explanation.definitionFit: Widely liked or admired describes something well-loved.

clue.text: Miserly to conceal court drink

indicators.note: the first word conceals, hides within itself, the second

parts.note: near is an old sense for stingy or miserly

explanation.surface: A stingy person hides a drink from the court.
explanation.definitionFit: The drink of the gods in Greek myth, or any delicious beverage.

clue.text: Man finds European Union position not new

indicators.note: not signals that the letter for new is left out

parts.note: a stance is a position, physical or on an issue

explanation.surface: A man discovers the EU's stance is nothing novel.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name, as in Eustace Tilley, so any man's name fits 'Man'.

clue.text: Refrain from using special metric unit

parts.note: an are is a metric unit of area, a hundred square metres

explanation.surface: Avoid using a particular measuring unit.
explanation.definitionFit: To not use something, as in sparing the rod, is to hold back from it.

clue.text: Greek character impressed by deep brown

indicators.note: pressed into the other piece, so it sits inside it

parts.note: the deep is a poetic name for the sea
pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek person awed by a rich dark-brown colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deep brown' looks like one colour, but 'deep' is the sea and 'brown' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Reddish-brown tone of old photographs, named after cuttlefish ink.

clue.text: A couple of billion people

parts.note: a race is a people, a nation

explanation.surface: Two out of a billion people, a tiny proportion.
explanation.definitionFit: A pair, especially of game birds shot, as in a brace of pheasants.

clue.text: Carrier has time to make progress — enemy losing heart

parts.note: to roll along is to make progress

indicators.note: losing heart means the middle letters are dropped, keeping only the outer ones

explanation.surface: A transport company takes time to advance while its foe is demoralised.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheeled cart, as in a supermarket, used to carry goods.

clue.text: Regular rest ordered for equestrian competitors

parts.note: even means regular or steady

indicators.note: ordered means put into a new sequence, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Riders are told to take a regular break.
explanation.definitionFit: Horse-and-rider pairs who take part in multi-discipline horse trials compete in this event.

clue.text: Group visit, finally, Brazilian port

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word before it

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a major Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A band ends its tour by visiting a Brazilian harbour city.
explanation.definitionFit: A threesome, any set of three, is a small group.
